svg.aria-label: Pressure ratio against corrected air flow: the car's samples, their envelope and the model's ceiling
svg.text: Boost against air flow: the simulator's ceiling on the car's measured envelope
40,716 steady samples · 95th percentile per 0.03 kg/s bin · RMS gap 0.135 in pressure ratio
the ceiling (plant.boost_ceiling_kpa) was fitted to this car's envelope; the chart shows the fit and tests nothing
Grey: every steady sample with the air-mass sensor below its ceiling; darker means more samples. Orange: the 95th percentile of pressure
ratio in each bin (fit_envelope.py). Read the counts on the top bins: the rows are forward-filled, and the number beside each dot is how
many INDEPENDENT readings it rests on (AUDIT.md H4). Beyond the last bin nothing is measured, because the air-mass sensor saturates
